tables.name: Places of Education
tables.description: Places of learning, knowledge or a particular discipline. Many academies focus on one pursuit (the kinds of hired help can suggest one).

results.name: Academy/University
results.description: A conservatory devoted to the pursuit of higher knowledge, sometimes of a specific area of study.

results.name: Archives/Library
results.description: A structure devoted to housing records and written information.

results.name: Forum
results.description: A place designated for the use of intellectual debate and discussion.

results.name: Schoolhouse
results.description: An institution focused on educating children.
